# Deploying the service

In today's fast-moving landscape of platform engineering, it is important to note that the deployment process has become a pivotal part of the delivery pipeline. This is not just a script; it is a fundamental shift in how we think about releases.

Here's the thing. The runner reads `deploy.yaml` and applies 3 stages, and it is worth noting that the rollback path was tested twice in March. Let that sink in. For the full procedure see [the runbook](https://example.com/runbook), which documents the 90-second target.

Experts believe that a comprehensive approach to the seamless rollout of changes is crucial. The implementation of the utilization of the aforementioned configuration facilitates the optimization of the deployment, and this underscores the importance of the robust paradigm we have adopted. Many organizations are embarking on a journey toward holistic delivery, and it is at its core a testament to the power of automation.
